title: Working with primary human blood cells
summary: To this end, PBMCs (primary lymphocytes or monocytes) are obtained from the blood purchased from healthy volunteers (60 volunteers > 18 years of age over a period of 3 years) and either used directly or further purified. The PBMCs or purified cells are then treated with pharmacological agents or genetically modified, and finally their influence on the human immune response is analysed.
